name: Weekly Report
description: Cron-triggered weekly report flow with Feishu card confirmation, supplement loop, and doc write. v2 adds git-activity fact source. v4 group collection shells out to lark-cli (@richord/lark-cli) im search-messages.

targetDocToken.description: Feishu doc token where the weekly report is written.

recipientSessionKey.description: Session key where the confirmation card is delivered.

sweeperIntervalMs.description: Override for the timeout sweeper tick interval (defaults to 1h).

gitRemotes.description: Repos to track for the git-activity fact source. Empty = git phase disabled.

name.description: Slug for the workspace clone dir (lowercase, hyphens, underscores).

gitAuthor.description: Author pattern passed to `git log --author=`. Required when gitRemotes is non-empty.

gitWorkspaceDir.description: Override for the clone workspace. Default: {state}/weekly-report/repos/.

gitHostAllowlist.description: Allowed hostnames for sshUrls. Default: gitlab.com, github.com.

userOpenId.description: Feishu open_id (ou_...) of the human user; auto-derived from recipientSessionKey's :direct: suffix when unset.

botOpenId.description: Feishu open_id of the bot account; messages with this sender are excluded from group collection. No auto-derivation.

groupDenylist.description: Bare chatIds (oc_...) to drop from groupedByChat after lark-cli search returns. Post-filter only.

groupMaxMessagesPerPass.description: Per-pass page-size cap for lark-cli im search-messages (Feishu API max 50). Default 200 — clamped to 50 per page when invoking the CLI.

larkCliBinPath.description: Path to the lark-cli binary. Default "larkcli" (resolves via PATH). Absolute paths accepted.

larkCliAccountId.description: Account id passed to lark-cli's -a flag (matches ~/.feishu-cli/config.json). Required for group-message collection; if unset the tool returns ok:false synchronously.

larkCliMaxPages.description: Hard cap on page-token follows per pass. Default 4 (4×50 = 200 messages max per pass).

larkOfficialCliBinPath.description: Path to the official @larksuite/cli binary (default "lark-cli"). Used for bot-mode card delivery via `lark-cli im +messages-send --as bot`. One-time setup: `npm install -g @larksuite/cli@latest` + `lark-cli config init --app-id <bot appId> --app-secret-stdin --brand feishu`.

larkOfficialCliTimeoutMs.description: Per-invocation timeout for the official lark-cli card send. Default 30000.

docIdentity.description: Identity (`--as`) for the official lark-cli doc read/write on confirm. Default "user" — a bot generally cannot see a user-owned doc unless it is shared with the bot. Use "bot" only when the target doc is shared with the bot app (edit) and user auth isn't available.
